name: Raa Bistro
blurb: A new cafe in Park Circus with a relaxed vibe, elegant interiors and a comforting menu of coffee and hearty bites.

tips.expect: A calm, stylish coffee stop.
tips.tip: Handy between the Central and South Kolkata circuits.

name: AMPM (Park Street)
blurb: A Park Street cafe by day that turns into a bar by night. Named Best Bar in Kolkata and ranked No. 12 on the 30 Best Bars India list.
dishes: Before PM Martini (Bengali chilli liqueur, tequila, espresso)
Park Street Negroni with coffee-infused whisky

tips.expect: A seamless day-to-night format with live energy after dark.
tips.tip: A good Park Street stop before or after the Central pandals.

name: The Bhawanipur House
blurb: An all-day cafe in Bhowanipore that won Best All Day Cafe at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: A comfortable all-day sit-down.
tips.tip: Close to the Bhowanipore and Kalighat routes.

name: ICanFlyy Tea Kafi
blurb: A tea and coffee cafe run by staff with special needs, with exposed brick walls and motivational quotes.

tips.expect: A small, warm, feel-good cafe.
tips.tip: Near Ballygunge, so easy to add to the Gariahat and Ballygunge pandals.

name: Travelistan Cafe
blurb: A travel-themed cafe at Golf Green with a world-map ceiling and Tintin characters on the walls.

tips.expect: A playful, themed room for a long chat.
tips.watch: It is on the far south side, so plan it with the Jadavpur and Naktala pandals.

name: Artsy - Coffee & Culture
blurb: Billed as Kolkata's first art cafe: whitewashed walls hung with artworks, an indoor faux gazebo and a European-piazza feel.

tips.expect: Pretty and calm, good for photos.
tips.tip: A quiet pause on the Bhowanipore side.

name: Perima's
blurb: A fun-dining bistro rooted in South Indian flavours.

tips.expect: Playful South Indian plates.
tips.tip: A light change from rich Puja food.

name: Park Street SOCIAL
blurb: A lively all-day cafe-bar on Park Street with a creative menu and co-working-meets-cafe energy.

tips.expect: Busy and social, loud on weekends.
tips.tip: On the Park Street strip with AMPM, Mocambo and Trincas.

name: Mintelaa - By the Air
blurb: A Salt Lake Sector 1 restaurant that won Best Fine Dining and Best All Day Cafe at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: A polished sit-down meal.
tips.tip: A good dinner after the Salt Lake block pandals.

name: Sonar Tori (Salt Lake)
blurb: A Salt Lake Bengali restaurant that won Best Bengali Food Experience at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: A proper Bengali sit-down meal.
tips.tip: Close to the Salt Lake pandals.

name: Oh! Calcutta
blurb: A well-known Bengali restaurant at Forum Mall on Elgin Road, among the city's top-rated restaurants.

tips.expect: Refined Bengali food in a mall setting.
tips.watch: Mall hours apply, and it fills up on Puja weekends.
tips.tip: Handy for the Elgin Road and Bhowanipore side.

name: Bhojohori Manna (Ballygunge)
blurb: The Ballygunge outlet of the Bengali chain that won Taste of Bengal at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026. About ₹390 a head on Google.

tips.expect: Reliable home-style Bengali plates.
tips.tip: A practical lunch near the Gariahat and Ballygunge pandals.

name: Kasturi Food Plaza
blurb: Kasturi Food Plaza in Ballygunge, listed among the best Bengali restaurants for home-style thalis and Bangladeshi cooking.

tips.expect: A busy, no-frills Bengali meal.
tips.tip: Near Gariahat.

name: Calcutta Nostalgia
blurb: A Bengali restaurant near Mudiali and Lake Market, listed among the best Bengali restaurants.

tips.expect: Old-Calcutta flavours.
tips.tip: Close to Mudiali Club and the Kalighat pandals.

name: Allen Kitchen
blurb: A long-standing Bengali eatery in North Kolkata, rated about 4.3 from nearly 2,800 reviews.

tips.expect: Straightforward Bengali food.
tips.tip: A natural meal stop on the Baghbazar and Hatibagan circuit.

name: Dilkhusha Cabin
blurb: An old-style cabin eatery by College Street.

tips.expect: A no-frills cabin from old Calcutta.
tips.tip: Pair it with the College Street baris and the Indian Coffee House.

name: Kwality (Park Street)
blurb: Kwality on Park Street, an old-school Indian restaurant (Google lists it as a heritage Indian restaurant).

tips.expect: Classic North Indian and Mughlai plates.
tips.tip: On the Park Street stretch.

name: Mocambo
blurb: A Park Street classic, named in the Conde Nast India x District Top Restaurant Awards 2025. Rated about 4.3 from over 17,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A retro dining room and bar.
tips.watch: Very popular. Book for Puja evenings.
tips.tip: Part of the Park Street cluster.

name: Shiraz Golden Restaurant
blurb: A Mughlai restaurant at Park Circus, rated about 4.1 from nearly 9,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A busy Mughlai and biryani meal.
tips.tip: A Park Circus stop between the central and south circuits.

name: Zeeshan
blurb: A Mughlai restaurant at Park Circus, rated about 4.0 from nearly 5,000 reviews.

tips.expect: Quick, filling Mughlai food.
tips.tip: Near Shiraz and Park Circus.

name: PaPaYa Modern Asian Bistro
blurb: PaPaYa, a modern Asian bistro on Park Street that won Best Sushi at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: Polished pan-Asian plates and sushi.
tips.tip: On Park Street.

name: Yauatcha Kolkata
blurb: A dim sum restaurant at Quest Mall that won Best Pan-Asian at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: Upscale dim sum and Asian plates.
tips.tip: Combine with the Ballygunge pandals.

name: Someplace Else
blurb: A pub at The Park on Park Street, known for rock and live music.

tips.expect: A classic Park Street pub night.
tips.tip: Part of the Park Street bar strip.

name: Roots (Chowringhee)
blurb: A rooftop pub on Chowringhee that won Best Rooftop Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: A rooftop drinks-and-bites crowd.
tips.tip: Close to Elgin Road and the Esplanade end of the Central circuit.

name: Glook The Sky Lounge
blurb: A sky lounge that won Best View at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: City views from a rooftop lounge.
tips.watch: It is out in New Town, away from the main Puja circuits.
tips.tip: Only worth it if you are already out that way.

name: Ambrosia Bar and Restaurant
blurb: A Salt Lake bar and restaurant that won Best Cocktail Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: Cocktails in a polished setting.
tips.tip: A Salt Lake evening stop after the block pandals.

name: La Soirée Kolkata
blurb: A new fine-dining and lounge space in Bhowanipore that won Best Cocktail Bar at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026.

tips.expect: A stylish lounge and cocktails.
tips.tip: A drink on the Bhowanipore side.

name: Little Bit Sober
blurb: A Bhowanipore cocktail bar that builds drinks around Bengal ingredients such as gondhoraj lemon and nolen gur.

tips.expect: Local-flavour cocktails.
tips.tip: Near Bhowanipore.

name: The Junction (Alipore)
blurb: A historic Alipore whisky bar with rare single malts and a British-era feel.

tips.expect: A quiet, old-school whisky bar.
tips.watch: Only a few reviews (about 60), so check before you go.
tips.tip: Near the Alipore pandals.

name: Olterra (Park Street)
blurb: An artisanal brewery and cocktail bar on Park Street with Greek-myth decor. Rated about 4.8 from over 2,700 reviews.

tips.expect: Craft beer and cocktails in a showy room.
tips.tip: On the Park Street strip.

name: Sen Mahasay
blurb: A North Kolkata sweet shop rated about 4.3 from over 900 reviews.

tips.expect: Counter-service mishti.
tips.tip: A sweet stop on the Hatibagan and Maniktala side.

name: Girish Ch. Dey & Nakur Ch. Nandy
blurb: A famous Bagbazar sweet shop, rated about 4.6 from nearly 11,000 reviews.

tips.expect: Classic Bengali sweets.
tips.good: The very high rating from many reviewers.
tips.tip: Slot it into the Baghbazar and Kumartuli loop.

name: Putiram Sweets
blurb: Putiram Sweets on College Street, rated about 4.3 from nearly 4,000 reviews.

tips.expect: A busy counter with sweets and savouries.
tips.tip: Pair with College Square and the Indian Coffee House.

name: Bhim Chandra Nag
blurb: A traditional mishti shop in Bowbazar, rated about 4.4.

tips.expect: Classic sandesh-and-sweets counter.
tips.tip: Near the Central heritage circuit.

name: Balaram Mullick & Radharaman Mullick
blurb: A Bhowanipore mishti institution that won Best Mishti at the Kolkata EazyDiner Foodie Awards 2026. Rated about 4.3 from nearly 9,700 reviews.

tips.expect: A long-standing sweet shop.
tips.tip: Near the Bhowanipore and Kalighat routes.

name: Behala Club
blurb: A major South-West Kolkata pandal in Behala known for thought-provoking artistic direction by Bhabatosh Sutar.

tips.expect: Immersive artistic installation and massive crowds.
tips.tip: Combine with Behala Nutan Sangha.

name: Behala Nutan Sangha
blurb: Famous Behala pandal showcasing installations by Sanatan Dinda and social thematic concepts.

tips.expect: Thoughtful theme design and vibrant evening lights.
tips.tip: Located in the Behala pandal cluster.

name: Selimpur Club
blurb: A prominent Dhakuria pandal known for its intricate architectural themes and innovative lighting arrangements.

tips.expect: Grand architectural artwork and vibrant illumination.
tips.tip: Close to Babubagan Sarbojanin.

name: Babubagan Sarbojanin
blurb: Famous Dhakuria pandal celebrated for creating themes using antique collectibles, coin art, and ceramic craft.

tips.expect: Intricate detail work and long entry queues.
tips.tip: Near Dhakuria railway station.

name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
blurb: A top North Kolkata destination in Dum Dum Park featuring elaborate handicraft themes and artistic light designs.

tips.expect: Vibrant handicraft artwork and crowded avenues.
tips.tip: Part of the Dum Dum Park circuit.

name: K.C. Das (Esplanade)
blurb: The legendary sweet shop where Nobin Chandra Das's legacy birthed the Kolkata Rossogolla. A landmark opposite Esplanade Mansion.

tips.expect: Classic sweet shop counter.
tips.tip: Right by Esplanade Metro Station.

name: Nahoum & Sons
blurb: A 120-year-old Jewish bakery in New Market with original teakwood showcases, famous for rich fruit cake, lemon tarts, and rum balls.

tips.expect: Old-world charm and queue during festive seasons.
tips.tip: Located inside New Market main block.

name: Anand Restaurant
blurb: A revered Central Kolkata pure vegetarian institution serving authentic South Indian tiffins, crisp rava dosas, and filter coffee.

tips.expect: Bustling family atmosphere and quick service.
tips.tip: Near Chandni Chowk Metro Station.

name: Govinda's (ISKCON)
blurb: Pure sattvic vegetarian dining operated by ISKCON on Gurusaday Road, offering wholesome thalis, paneer delicacies, and pure ghee sweets.

tips.expect: Peaceful atmosphere and strictly vegetarian/onion-garlic-free food.
tips.tip: Near Beckbagan / Park Circus connector.

name: Chitto Babur Dokan (Dacres Lane)
blurb: The legendary street food stall in Dacres Lane (James Hickey Sarani) famous for buttered chicken stew, buttered toast, and fried cutlets.

tips.expect: Busy alleyway street food stall with high turnaround.
tips.tip: Best visited during day hours in Esplanade.

name: Oudh 1590 (Deshapriya Park)
blurb: Kolkata's pioneer period dining restaurant featuring royal Awadhi recipes, brassware, classical sitar music, and melt-in-mouth kebabs.

tips.expect: Royal Awadhi decor and aromatic Dum Biryani.
tips.tip: Opposite Priya Cinema at Deshapriya Park.

name: Nalin Chandra Das & Sons
blurb: A 175-year-old North Kolkata sweet maker famed for inventing Chocolate Sandesh and crafting iconic Jolbhora Talsas Sandesh.

tips.expect: Authentic North Kolkata mishti shop.
tips.tip: Located near Hedua Park.

name: Chowman (Golf Green)
blurb: The flagship outlet of Kolkata's favorite neighborhood Chinese chain, offering red-and-black cozy ambience and Chinese classics.

tips.expect: Cozy neighborhood Chinese dining.
tips.tip: Near Golf Green park.

name: Kasturi (Free School Street)
blurb: Pioneer of authentic Dhakai Bengali cuisine in Kolkata, famous for Kochu Pata Chingri Bhapa and aromatic Kanti dishes.

tips.expect: Rich Bangladeshi Bengali flavors.
tips.tip: On Mirza Ghalib Street / Free School Street.

name: Tung Fong (Park Street)
blurb: A Park Street staple for classic Tangra-style Chinese and lunch buffets, serving dim sums, Szechwan specials, and sizzling platters.

tips.expect: Generous portions and prompt family service.
tips.tip: Situated right on Park Street.

name: Sharma Tea House (Bhowanipore)
blurb: Famous South Kolkata Marwari breakfast joint serving hot piping Club Kachoris, crisp Jalebis, and saffron kulhad chai.

tips.expect: Bustling morning crowd standing around hot wok counters.
tips.tip: Near Exide / Rabindra Sadan Metro.

name: Maharani & Maharaja (Deshapriya Park)
blurb: Twin legendary eateries at Lake Market / Deshapriya Park corner, renowned for early morning Hing Kachori, Jalebi, and chai.

tips.expect: Classic South Kolkata morning breakfast hub.
tips.tip: Near Deshapriya Park pandal circuit.

name: Bedwin (Gariahat)
blurb: A South Kolkata institution near Gariahat crossing famous for flaky Kathi Rolls, Moghlai Parathas, and Biryani.

tips.expect: Quick grab-and-go roll counter.
tips.tip: Near Gariahat flyover.

name: Roastery Coffee House (Hindustan Park)
blurb: Housed inside a charming colonial bungalow in Hindustan Park, offering specialty pour-overs, Cascara, and patio seating.

tips.expect: Green courtyard setting and artisanal coffee menu.
tips.tip: In the heart of South Kolkata cafe lane.

name: Sienna Store & Cafe (Hindustan Park)
blurb: An award-winning farm-to-table cafe and ceramics studio serving seasonal local ingredients, handmade pasta, and specialty coffee.

tips.expect: Creative menu that changes seasonally with exquisite terracotta pottery.
tips.tip: Near Hindustan Park pandals.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters (Ballygunge)
blurb: Specialty coffee roastery in Ballygunge serving single-origin Indian coffees, fresh viennoiserie, and sourdough toasts.

tips.expect: Clean modern coffee lounge with high-speed wifi.
tips.tip: Near Southern Avenue.

name: Kewpie's Kitchen (Elgin)
blurb: Homestyle traditional Bengali restaurant inside a residential bungalow on Elgin Lane, serving thalis in terra-cotta dishes.

tips.expect: Warm homestyle hospitality and authentic family recipes.
tips.tip: Off Elgin Road.

name: Dacres Lane Chowmein & Cutlet Stalls
blurb: Kolkata's most famous street food alley near Raj Bhavan, famous for wok-tossed Kolkata Desi Chowmein and Fish Cutlets.

tips.expect: High-energy lunchtime street food experience.
tips.tip: Near Esplanade / BBD Bagh.

name: Ganguram & Sons (Maniktala)
blurb: A 130-year-old sweet institution legendary for its morning Radhaballavi served with spiced Alur Dom and Indrani mishti.

tips.expect: Busy sweet counter, especially for Sunday morning breakfast.
tips.tip: Near Maniktala crossing.

name: Tewari Brothers (Burrabazar)
blurb: Central Kolkata's premier pure veg Ghee sweet shop, world-famous for crisp pure ghee Samosas, Raj Kachori, and Gulab Jamun.

tips.expect: Fresh hot Ghee fried samosas made continuously.
tips.tip: In Burrabazar / Mahatma Gandhi Road.

name: Haldiram's Prabhuji (Burrabazar)
blurb: The iconic Central Kolkata branch of Prabhuji Haldiram's serving pure vegetarian Chole Bhature, Pav Bhaji, and Dhokla.

tips.expect: Busy multi-counter pure veg eatery.
tips.tip: Near MG Road Metro Station.

name: Koley Market Night Street Food Stalls
blurb: Night-owl street food hub outside Sealdah station operating till dawn during Puja, famous for hot Puri Sabzi, Chai, and Egg Rolls.

tips.expect: 24x7 street food energy next to Sealdah terminal.
tips.tip: Perfect late-night stop after Sealdah pandals.

name: Bijoli Grill (Bhowanipore)
blurb: Kolkata's legendary fish fry and catering brand, renowned for its crunchy Bhetki Fish Fry, Fish Orly, and Mutton Kabiraji.

tips.expect: Classic Kolkata fry and cutlet standard bearer.
tips.tip: Near Bhowanipore / Netaji Bhavan Metro.

name: Dada Boudi Biryani (Kolkata Hub)
blurb: Famous Biryani institution renowned across Bengal for massive portions, ultra-tender large mutton pieces, and rich flavorful rice.
dishes: Special Mutton Biryani with Potato & Egg

tips.expect: Huge crowds and generous biryani portions.
tips.tip: North Kolkata / Belgharia road.

name: Santa's Fantasea (Golpark)
blurb: Unique tribal and seafood specialty restaurant serving Nagaland Bamboo Shoot Mutton, Odisha Tribal Chicken, and fresh Crabs.

tips.expect: Underwater and tribal-themed decor with exotic seafood.
tips.tip: Near Golpark crossing.

name: Hatari (Triangular Park)
blurb: A beloved South Kolkata family restaurant near Triangular Park serving nostalgic Indo-Chinese, Kebabs, and classic sizzlers.

tips.expect: Nostalgic family atmosphere right on Rashbehari Avenue.
tips.tip: Adjacent to Triangular Park.

name: Peter Hu? (Park Street)
blurb: A stylish modern Pan-Asian dining destination on Park Street created by the team behind Peter Cat and Mocambo.

tips.expect: Chic modern Asian interiors with craft mocktails.
tips.tip: On Park Street next to Peter Cat.

name: Artsun Cafe (Bhowanipore)
blurb: A serene art cafe housed in a restored Bhowanipore courtyard, featuring rotating local art exhibitions and artisanal coffees.

tips.expect: Quiet artistic courtyard hideaway.
tips.tip: Near Netaji Bhavan.

name: Calcutta Bakery Cafe (Hindustan Park)
blurb: A cozy bakery cafe specializing in freshly baked sourdough breads, butter croissants, flaky quiches, and pour-over coffee.

tips.expect: Aroma of freshly baked sourdough every morning.
tips.tip: In Hindustan Park lane.
